composition: Brick coach house on a low dark glass strip, museum closed · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The Drents Museum entrance in Assen is the old brick coach house, raised only a short step on a glass strip, with its historic facade kept. After midnight the museum is closed, so the glass is dark and only a path lamp lights the brick. A low grass roof with a curved skylight sits beside it. The sky is mainly clear, about 11.2°C, with wind near 7.2 km/h. Sunset was 19:22. Trees are still in leaf.
